title: Long Melon (Kakri): modeled ₹239/qtl left, Naraingarh → Ganaur
summary: April 2022: reported long Melon (Kakri) prices at Naraingarh and Ganaur imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 85% of 13 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹239 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 12 same-variety market pairs screened for long Melon (Kakri) in April 2022; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Ganaur report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: April 2022
scenes.caption: Naraingarh (Haryana) and Ganaur (Haryana) both reported long Melon (Kakri) prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 13 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Naraingarh reported a median ₹1,100 per quintal. Ganaur reported a median ₹1,600 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹400/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹400 per quintal, and Ganaur was dearer on 92% of days.

scenes.headline: 172 km by road
scenes.caption: 172 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹37/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹231 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹151 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Ganaur report, the rule selects 12 of 12 modeled shipping days. 11 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹239 per quintal (₹149 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Long Melon (Kakri) route from Naraingarh to Ganaur was positive on 85% of matched days in April 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹23,900, or ₹14,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to long Melon (Kakri)
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹37/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Long Melon (Kakri) route from Naraingarh to Ganaur was positive on 85% of matched days in April 2022. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹23,900, or ₹14,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

sources.title: Agmarknet / data.gov.in daily mandi modal prices (retained AGRINET snapshot)
